background_meme.prompt: A moody late-night campus hackathon floor: rows of glowing laptop screens in a dim auditorium, string lights overhead, soft blue-purple ambient glow, empty energy drink cans on tables, dark negative space in the center/lower half for the hosts, no people, no text, no logos.

intro_meme.prompt: A cracked laptop screen with a single digital sprout growing out of a broken keyboard key, glowing green against a dark navy background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'BUILD SOMETHING THAT GROWS'.

outro_meme.prompt: A single green digital sprout growing out of a pile of empty energy drink cans and tangled charging cables, dark navy background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'GROWTH, TECHNICALLY'.

sources.fact: MHacks Fall 2026 runs October 3-4 in Ann Arbor, MI, free to attend, with 1,000+ student builders and sponsors including AWS, Meta, SpaceX, Capital One, and D.E. Shaw & Co.; regular applications closed September 12, 2026.

MHacks started in 2012 at the Bob and Betty Beyster Building, grew into the world's largest student-run hackathon and was held at Michigan Stadium, had no event in 2022, and returned in 2023 as MHacks 15.

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: Yoooo, guess what the actual fuck 'build something that grows' means at MHacks.

screen.prompt: A digital plant made of glowing green bug icons instead of leaves, sprouting from a cracked laptop screen, dark navy background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'THIS IS WHAT GROWTH LOOKS LIKE'.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Real growth is your bug count by hour eighteen with zero sleep, my ninja.
lines.voice_instructions: dry, deadpan delivery, especially flat on 'zero sleep'

screen.prompt: An exhausted cartoon hacker slumped face-first onto a keyboard at a desk, a huge red digital counter behind them reading '247' labeled 'BUGS', a wall clock showing 4:00, dark room lit only by screen glow, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'HOUR EIGHTEEN'.

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: October third and fourth, Ann Arbor — AWS, Meta, SpaceX, Capital One, all in the building.

screen.prompt: A row of generic corporate recruiting booths with plain blank banner signs, no logos, no brand names, a line of exhausted students in hoodies waiting, a judge in a blazer holding a clipboard and stopwatch, dark convention-hall lighting, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'THEY'RE WATCHING'.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: So the 'garden' is really a demo table where your app crashes in front of a SpaceX engineer.

screen.prompt: A hackathon demo table with a laptop displaying a bright red crash error screen, a small potted plant with a wilted brown leaf next to it, a garden trowel on the table, dark stage lighting, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'APP.EXE STOPPED GROWING'.

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: And you just smile like that wasn't the whole-ass presentation.

screen.prompt: Extreme close-up cartoon face with a huge forced fake smile, beads of sweat flying off, a tiny reflection of a red crash screen visible in the glasses lenses, dark background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'TOTALLY FINE'.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: This thing started 2012 in the Beyster Building — blew up so big it took over Michigan Stadium.

screen.prompt: A split-panel illustration: left side a small cramped room with three laptops glowing, right side the same scene exploded into a massive packed football stadium full of glowing laptop screens under stadium lights, dark navy background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'ONE ROOM TO THE BIG HOUSE'.

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: Then it just flatlined. No MHacks in 2022. Straight-up dead.

screen.prompt: A cartoon tombstone shaped like a laptop screen in an empty dark graveyard, cobwebs draped across the keyboard, a single dead vine wrapped around it, faint moonlight, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'MHACKS 2022: NONE'.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Came back in 2023 swinging — beautiful story. Except regular applications already closed September twelfth.

screen.prompt: A glowing green sprout bursting up out of cracked earth in the shape of a laptop, a giant red rubber stamp slamming down on top of it reading exactly 'CLOSED', dark navy background, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'REBORN. ALSO CLOSED.'

lines.speaker: nate
lines.text: So if you're hyped watching this, my ninja, you already missed the boat. That's not growth, that's a rain check.
lines.voice_instructions: land the punchline hard on 'rain check'

screen.prompt: A small wooden dock at night, a single cartoon figure in a hoodie standing alone holding a laptop, watching a boat strung with lights sail away into the dark distance, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'SEPT 12TH LEFT WITHOUT YOU'.

lines.speaker: kai
lines.text: Doesn't matter. The grind's the same whether you're in that room or not — question is whether you look the part.

screen.prompt: A hoodie draped over an empty desk chair next to a glowing laptop at night, a single green sprout growing out of the laptop's cracked corner, warm desk lamp light, dark room, bold white outlined caption exactly reading 'THE GRIND DOESN'T CHECK RSVPS'.
